steps.name: publish
argv:
import glob, hashlib, os, shutil
dst = "C:/banyan-farm/courier-box/farm-out/motion-poscontrol-plates-0816"
os.makedirs(dst, exist_ok=True)
shutil.copy2(r"C:\banyan-farm\motion-poscontrol-plates-0816\\SOURCES.md", dst)
src = sorted(glob.glob("C:/banyan-farm/motion-poscontrol-plates-0816-out/poscontrol-*-src.jpg")) + [os.path.join(dst, "SOURCES.md")]
lines = []
for f in src:
    if os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(f)) != os.path.abspath(dst):
        shutil.copy2(f, dst)
    c = os.path.join(dst, os.path.basename(f))
    with open(c, "rb") as fh:
        h = hashlib.sha256(fh.read()).hexdigest()
    lines.append(h + "  " + os.path.basename(f))
with open(os.path.join(dst, "motion-poscontrol-plates-0816.sha256"), "w", newline="\n") as fh:
    fh.write("\n".join(sorted(lines)) + "\n")
print("published", len(src), "file(s) + manifest ->", dst)
raise SystemExit(0 if len(src) >= 3 else 1)
